name: Anemia
overview: Anaemia is reduced haemoglobin or red blood cell mass, causing fatigue and weakness. Iron deficiency from poor intake or blood loss is the most common cause in Indian women and children.
symptoms: Brittle nails and hair loss in iron deficiency
causes: Iron deficiency (nutritional, menstrual blood loss, hookworm)
Haemolytic anaemias and bone marrow disorders
diagnosis: Complete blood count and peripheral smear
Stool occult blood or endoscopy if GI loss suspected
treatment: Treat underlying cause (hookworm, menorrhagia, GI bleed)
B12 injections or oral folate as indicated
Blood transfusion in severe symptomatic anaemia
prevention: Iron-rich diet (leafy greens, legumes, jaggery, meat if consumed)
Vitamin C with iron meals to improve absorption
Antenatal iron and folic acid supplementation
complications: Heart failure from chronic severe anaemia
emergencySigns: Chest pain or heart failure symptoms

faq.question: Can I rely on this Anemia information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Anemia symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
